Tasty food, big servings
Oct 2025 • Couples
It’s one of many restaurants along the busy street, but the first thing that attracted us was the great ambience. We took a lift upstairs which was great for our tired legs after 2 days of hiking. We took a table by the window, which gave us a great view of the street. The serving was big, and every dish was tasty. We especially liked the pork fried with galangal. It is just a little pricey, but worth it.
